text: The agency must give reasons for the automated decision to each affected person.
Each affected person must be able to request and obtain reasons for the decision.

Every department operating an automated service must
explain its decision outputs to affected people.

AI service owners must disclose to affected people the uncertainty
and limitations of each automated decision output.

Where an incident is detected, the operator must escalate the matter
for approval by the authorised officer.

The organisation must

explain decision outputs in this example text.

The policy requires investigation by an independent body and a restoration plan reviewed by the oversight authority.
An independent audit of the governance committee is mandatory.
